propositions: An out-of-window-but-alive key must reach clear_absent during reconcile pass 2 with zero mutations, zero Jira writes, unchanged updated_at, and stable bindings.json/tracker HEAD across a repeated pass.
Seeding an unconditional updated_at stamp in BindingLifecycle.clear_absent causes the out-of-window idempotency test to fail by mutating updated_at when no churn should occur.
The test harness must wire the diff-phase backend to use the fake transport (not a real Jira backend) so synthetic out-of-window and deleted keys are reachable without 404s from a real backend.

A 404 response on a bound-but-absent key must trigger note_absent to record absence with the lifecycle clock sentinel, then a subsequent alive state must trigger clear_absent to reset the absence counter.
Dropping the clear_absent call in outbound_mutation_builders.py causes the reach spy assertion to fail, indicating a regression in the out-of-window binding path.
Regression in clear_absent's clearing branch (absence counter not reset) causes the 404-to-alive roundtrip test to fail on counter validation.
